description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Current is a consumer fintech platform serving members with financial products. The iOS Software Engineer builds native mobile experiences, owns features from design through launch, and contributes to reusable mobile frameworks in collaboration with product, design, and backend teams.
iOS Software Engineer building financial-product features and reusable mobile frameworks, owning delivery from design handoff through launch

Responsibilities:
• Be part of a small and nimble mobile engineering team working closely with our product, design, and backend engineering teams to ship end-to-end experiences for our users
• Own features from design handoff through launch, with support from senior engineers on system design and architecture decisions
• Contribute to and learn our scalable, reusable mobile frameworks that improve code consistency and engineering velocity
• Build strong instincts for engineering excellence through active participation in code and architecture review
• Help Current's members build better financial futures through products like Paycheck Advance, Build Card, and Savings Pods
• A strong culture of code and architecture review, with real mentorship from senior teammates

Requirements:
• Proficient in Swift, with a working knowledge of its Concurrency model
• Understanding of core iOS fundamentals including app states, memory management, dependency injection, and persistence
• Experience building responsive user interfaces in a native iOS codebase (UIKit)
• Comfortable working within a modularized app architecture, or eager to learn patterns like MVC, unidirectional data flow, and the Coordinator design pattern
• Have shipped features on apps available on the App Store
• A genuine interest in the personal finance space!

Preferred:
• Experience using SwiftUI and its interfacing with UIKit
• Experience writing unit and UI tests with XCTest, XCUITest and Swift Testing
• Exposure to Instruments for profiling and optimizing app performance
• Experience using gRPC (Google Remote Procedure Call) and Protobuf (Protocol Buffers) schemas for networking
• Interest in building highly secure iOS apps
• Experience working on a team building platform components
